name: A flight aura lets a player fly in Outland but not on the classic continents
contract: Upstream #8631 made every flight aura inert for every player. On our realms Outland and Northrend keep flight,
which some of their quests and raids require; only the classic continents (Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor) ban it.
Flight Form 33943 carries SPELL_AURA_FLY. Applied directly in Orgrimmar it must not let the druid fly; applied
in Hellfire Peninsula it must. Without the classic ban the aura lets the druid fly in Orgrimmar too. free_flying reads
the server's view; can_fly waits for a client acknowledgement a test player never sends.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: Flight Form does not let the druid fly in Orgrimmar
Flight Form lets the druid fly in Hellfire Peninsula
